messages:
ashley: dropped a compact mock of an inline sampling pill inside the time selector for the heatmap/p95 dashboard. Pill shows current sampling like "sample 1/10" and opens a small flyout for range vs global + presets. proto: https://uploads/redwood/design/inline-sample.mp4

sam: looks promising. Two quick perf asks: 1) debounce redraw while scrubbing (maybe 150-250ms), 2) when switching sampling levels show a quick placeholder so the heatmap doesn't jump.

marta: UX: prefer the pill to include an indicator dot when sampling is active (orange) + tooltip copy: "Lower resolution for faster previews. Sampled metrics may miss spikes." Keep label short in the card: "p95 (sampled)".

ben: visual nit: preview overlay should have a dashed 1px outline and 48% opacity fill. The pill when open shows a small radio list: Range / Global / Full, and a tiny "Set as default" checkbox. I'll mock variants for mobile too (icon-only).

jin: telemetry: record origin=inline_time_pill, action=change_sampling, prev_rate, new_rate. Also track whether user promoted to default. We'll need a small UX for confirming promotion.

a11y-bot: accessibility: pill and flyout must be keyboard focusable, flyout role=listbox, options role=option, aria-selected set. Contrast: pill text 4.5:1, dashed outline meets 3:1 non-text. When sampling changes, announce with aria-live: "Sampling set to 1 in 10 for selected range".

sam: keyboard flow proposal: focus time selector -> Tab to pill -> Enter opens flyout -> ArrowUp/Down select -> Space to apply -> Esc to close. For scrub mode: Left/Right nudge by 1s, Shift+Left/Right nudge by 10s. I'll write this up in the keyboard doc.

marta: copy: flyout header: "Sampling for selected range". helper: "Lower resolution speeds queries; sampled p95 may not surface short spikes. Use Full for exact analysis." Also add subtle inline caption under the p95 metric: "p95 estimated (sampled)".

ben: mobile: icon-only pill opens full-screen sheet. Gesture: quick taps toggle presets, long-press opens fine-grain controls. Be careful with accidental long-press on Android.

ashley: summary/action items: Ben -> mocks for pill states + mobile sheet (EOD), Sam -> debounce numbers + keyboard spec (tomorrow), Marta -> final copy + caption (tomorrow), Jin -> telemetry event names + promotion flow (next sprint), a11y-bot -> run contrast and aria checks after mocks. I'll update the prototype to wire the pill and the placeholder behavior. :thumbsup:

a11y-bot: also flag: ensure any transient placeholder has a visible focusable node if it contains interactive elements.

sam: one last thing: let's add an experiment flag `inline_sampling_pill` so we can ramp behavior and measure retention on the tool.

marta: agreed. small UX test: if user enables sampling and the p95 drops by >30% versus full, show a non-modal banner: "Sampled values may underreport spikes. View full fidelity" with a quick toggle.

ashley: I'll include the banner in the mock flows. Thanks all!
